source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗ית בַּֽחֲמִשִׁי֙ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּ֧אוּ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְפָנָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the year the seventh, in the fifth, on the tenth of the month, came men from [the] elders of Israel to inquire of Yahweh, and they sat before me.

en.L: And it came about in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], on the tenth of the month, [that] men from the elders of Israel came in to inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they sat before me.
en.B: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, a group of Israel's elders came to consult {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they sat down in front of me.
en.R: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the seventh year of our exile, some of the elders of Israel came to ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for a message. They sat down in front of me.

pt.L: E aconteceu no sétimo ano, no quinto [mês], no décimo [dia] do mês, [que] vieram homens dentre os anciãos de Israel para consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e se sentaram diante de mim.
pt.B: No sétimo ano, no quinto mês, no décimo dia do mês, alguns dos anciãos de Israel vieram consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e se sentaram na minha frente.
pt.R: No décimo dia do quinto mês, no sétimo ano do nosso exílio, alguns dos anciãos de Israel vieram pedir uma mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eles se sentaram na minha frente.

fr.L: Et il arriva, la septième année, au cinquième [mois], le dix du mois, [que] des hommes d’entre les anciens d’Israël vinrent consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils s’assirent devant moi.
fr.B: La septième année, le cinquième mois, le dixième jour du mois, quelques-uns des anciens d’Israël vinrent consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils s’assirent devant moi.
fr.R: Le dixième jour du cinquième mois, la septième année de notre exil, quelques anciens d’Israël sont venus demander un message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils se sont assis devant moi.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año séptimo, en el [mes] quinto, a los diez [días] del mes, [que] vinieron algunos hombres de los ancianos de Israel a consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y se sentaron delante de mí.
es.B: En el año séptimo, en el mes quinto, el día diez del mes, algunos de los ancianos de Israel vinieron a consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y se sentaron delante de mí.
es.R: El día diez del quinto mes, en el séptimo año de nuestro destierro, algunos de los ancianos de Israel vinieron a pedir un mensaje {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Se sentaron delante de mí.

vi.L: Và xảy ra vào năm thứ bảy, [tháng] thứ năm, ngày mồng mười trong tháng, có những người trong các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên đến để cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ ngồi trước mặt tôi.
vi.B: Ngày mồng mười tháng năm, năm thứ bảy, có mấy trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên đến cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ ngồi xuống trước mặt tôi.
vi.R: Vào ngày mồng mười tháng năm, năm thứ bảy của thời lưu đày chúng tôi, có mấy trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên đến xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho một sứ điệp. Họ ngồi xuống trước mặt tôi.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa saba, katika [mwezi] wa tano, siku ya kumi ya mwezi, watu kutoka kwa wazee wa Israeli wakaja kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakaketi mbele yangu.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa saba, mwezi wa tano, siku ya kumi ya mwezi, baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli walikuja kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} shauri, wakaketi mbele yangu.
sw.R: Siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa tano, katika mwaka wa saba wa uhamisho wetu, baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli walikuja kumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awape ujumbe. Wakaketi mbele yangu.

ko.L: 그리고 제7년 다섯째 달 십일에 이스라엘의 장로들 가운데 몇 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 물으려고 와서 내 앞에 앉았다.
ko.B: 7년째 되는 해 다섯째 달 십일에, 이스라엘의 장로 몇 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 뜻을 여쭈려고 와서 내 앞에 앉았다.
ko.R: 우리가 포로로 끌려온 지 7년째 되는 해 다섯째 달 십일에, 이스라엘의 장로 몇 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들으려고 나를 찾아왔다. 그들은 내 앞에 앉았다.

am.L: በሰባተኛውም ዓመት፣ በአምስተኛው [ወር]፣ ከወሩም በአሥረኛው [ቀን] እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች አንዳንድ ሰዎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሊጠይቁ መጡ፤ በፊቴም ተቀመጡ።
am.B: በሰባተኛው ዓመት፣ በአምስተኛው ወር፣ ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች አንዳንዶቹ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለመጠየቅ መጥተው በፊቴ ተቀመጡ።
am.R: በስደታችን በሰባተኛው ዓመት፣ በአምስተኛው ወር፣ በአሥረኛው ቀን ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች አንዳንዶቹ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} መልእክት ለመጠየቅ መጡ። በፊቴም ተቀመጡ።

hi.L: और सातवें वर्ष के पाँचवें [महीने] में, महीने के दसवें [दिन], ऐसा हुआ कि इस्राएल के पुरनियों में से कुछ पुरुष {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से पूछने आए, और मेरे सामने बैठ गए।
hi.B: सातवें वर्ष के पाँचवें महीने के दसवें दिन इस्राएल के कुछ बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से पूछने के लिए आए और मेरे सामने बैठ गए।
hi.R: हमारी बंधुआई के सातवें वर्ष के पाँचवें महीने के दसवें दिन, इस्राएल के कुछ बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से संदेश पूछने आए। वे मेरे सामने बैठ गए।

ru.L: И было в седьмой год, в пятый [месяц], в десятый [день] месяца, пришли люди из старейшин Израиля вопросить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и сели передо мной.
ru.B: В седьмой год, в пятый месяц, в десятый день месяца, несколько старейшин Израиля пришли вопросить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и сели передо мной.
ru.R: В десятый день пятого месяца, в седьмой год нашего изгнания, ко мне пришли некоторые старейшины Израиля, чтобы спросить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} о его воле. Они сели передо мной.

ja.L: 第七年の第五[の月]、その月の十日のことである。イスラエルの長老たちのうちの何人かが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に伺いを立てるためにやって来て、わたしの前に座った。
ja.B: 第七年の第五の月の十日、イスラエルの長老たちのうちの何人かが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に伺いを立てるために来て、わたしの前に座った。
ja.R: それは、わたしたちが捕虜として連れて来られてから七年目の、第五の月の十日のことでした。イスラエルの長老たちの何人かが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のお告げを求めてやって来て、わたしの前に座りました。

uk.L: І сталося сьомого року, пʼятого [місяця], десятого [дня] місяця, [що] прийшли чоловіки зі старійшин Ізраїлю питати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і сіли переді мною.
uk.B: Сьомого року, пʼятого місяця, десятого дня місяця, кілька старійшин Ізраїлю прийшли спитати поради в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і сіли переді мною.
uk.R: Десятого дня пʼятого місяця, сьомого року нашого вигнання, дехто зі старійшин Ізраїлю прийшов попросити в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} вістки. Вони сіли переді мною.

decisions.choice: the seventh year, the fifth month, the tenth day: counted from King Jehoiachin's exile, about August 591 BC
decisions.reason: Ezekiel dates his visions by the years since King Jehoiachin was taken to Babylon in 597 BC (1:2; 8:1). The seventh year of that exile, in the fifth month, falls in the summer of 591 BC, eleven months after the vision of 8:1 and about five years before Jerusalem fell (33:21).

decisions.choice: to inquire of the LORD: to ask for a word from the LORD through his prophet
decisions.reason: To "inquire of the LORD" was to come to a prophet for God's answer to a question or a need (1 Kings 22:7-8; 2 Kings 22:13-18). Elders of the exiles had come to Ezekiel in the same way in 8:1 and 14:1. The chapter does not say what they asked; the LORD's answer is that he will not be consulted by them (verses 3 and 31).

decisions.choice: in the seventh year of our exile
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives only the number of the year. Readable says what the years are counted from (m1), and puts the day and month first, as people say a date.

decisions.choice: L keeps the Hebrew order "năm thứ bảy, [tháng] thứ năm, ngày mồng mười trong tháng"; B and R give the Vietnamese order "ngày mồng mười tháng năm, năm thứ bảy"
alternatives: the Hebrew order at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form for Ezekiel's dated headings: Vietnamese writes day, month, year; days 1-10 take "mồng". No level converts to a modern date; the meaning decision gives it.

decisions.choice: 제7년 다섯째 달 십일 (L); 7년째 되는 해 다섯째 달 십일 (B, R)
decisions.reason: The dated headings follow the Kings and Jeremiah formula: the year in figures, months and days in words (Jer 52:4; 39:2). Readable adds "since we were taken captive", as the English R does.

decisions.choice: Ezekiel's own narrative frame in the passé simple at L and B ("vinrent", "s'assirent") and the passé composé at R ("sont venus"); God's speech that follows uses the tenses of speech at every level
decisions.reason: French style guide §3 and the Ezekiel term sheet: first-person narrative is told like other narrative, while oracles are speech.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; the Amharic text carries no such spans in this chapter.

decisions.choice: पुरनिए (L); बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे (B, R)
decisions.reason: The elders take the forms the style guide and Ezra settle.

decisions.choice: हमारी बंधुआई के सातवें वर्ष
decisions.reason: Readable says the years are counted from the exile (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: в седьмой год нашего изгнания
decisions.reason: Readable says what the years are counted from (m1) and puts the day and month first, as the English does.

decisions.choice: вопросить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} (L, B); спросить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} о его воле (R)
decisions.reason: To ask for a word from the LORD through his prophet (m2): "вопросить", as the Russian Ezekiel at 14:3; Readable says what was asked.

decisions.choice: Narrative frame plain at L and B, です・ます at R; the date as EZK 8:1 (第七年の第五[の月]、その月の十日 L; R counts from the exile as the English R).
decisions.reason: Ezekiel convention (notes EZK-1).

decisions.choice: darash 'et YHWH "主に伺いを立てる" (L, B), "主のお告げを求める" (R); the same verb in 20:3 and 20:31.
decisions.reason: m2: asking for a word through the prophet; 伺いを立てる as Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: the formula as in Jeremiah; the LORD's words that follow take no quotation marks
alternatives: quotation marks around the whole of the LORD's speech
decisions.reason: "The word of the LORD came to me, saying" keeps the wording set for Jeremiah at each level. Everything from verse 3 to the end of the chapter is the LORD's own speech. As in Isaiah and the other prophets, God's first-person speech takes no quotation marks; words quoted inside it, such as what God once said to Israel or what the people say, take double quotes.

decisions.choice: Vino a mí la palabra del SEÑOR, diciendo: (L); La palabra del SEÑOR vino a mí: (B); El SEÑOR me dio este mensaje: (R); the oracle that follows takes no quotation marks
alternatives: Y vino a mí palabra del SEÑOR, diciendo:
decisions.reason: The formula is worded as in Spanish Jeremiah 1:4 at each level. As in the English, God's oracle after it is not set in « », and the message Ezekiel is told to deliver takes none either; only human speech quoted inside it takes « ».

decisions.choice: "Lời của CHÚA đến với tôi rằng:" / "Lời CHÚA đến với tôi:" / "CHÚA ban cho tôi sứ điệp này:"
alternatives: "Có lời CHÚA phán với tôi rằng"
decisions.reason: The formula as published in Jeremiah 1:4, kept through Ezekiel. God's words that follow take no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 말씀하셨다 (L); …임했다 (B); {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 이 말씀을 주셨다 (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording of the formula, as Jeremiah 1:4. Ezekiel narrates in the plain style and gives God -시-; what God then says is in 해라체 and takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "Neno la BWANA likanijia, kusema:" (L); "Neno la BWANA likanijia:" (B); "BWANA alinipa ujumbe huu:" (R); the oracle that follows takes no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The formula as in Swahili Jeremiah 1:4, fixed by the term sheet for these books. As in the English, God's words after it are not set in quotation marks; speech quoted inside them is.

decisions.choice: "Et la parole du SEIGNEUR me fut adressée, disant :" (L); "La parole du SEIGNEUR me fut adressée :" (B); "Le SEIGNEUR m'a donné ce message :" (R), for the whole book
alternatives: "La parole du SEIGNEUR vint à moi"
decisions.reason: The formula as in French Jeremiah; the oracle that follows takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: И было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} ко мне, говоря: (L); {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обратился ко мне: (B); {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал мне такое слово: (R)
alternatives: И было ко мне слово Господне
decisions.reason: The prophets note's wording for this formula; as in the English, the LORD's speech that follows (to the end of the chapter) takes no quotation marks.

source.text: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶת־זִקְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הֲלִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם בָּאִ֑ים חַי־אָ֨נִי֙ אִם־אִדָּרֵ֣שׁ לָכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, speak to [the] elders of Israel and say to them, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Is [it] to inquire of me [that] you [are] coming? [As] I live, I will not be inquired of by you, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Is it to inquire of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [that] you are coming? As I live, I will not be inquired of by you, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel. Say to them, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Have you come to consult {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? As surely as I live, I will not let you consult {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel. Tell them, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: Have you come to ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for a message? As surely as I live, I will not answer you, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: Filho do homem, fala aos anciãos de Israel e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: É para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consultar [que] vocês vêm? [Tão certo como] eu vivo, não me deixarei consultar por vocês, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.B: Filho do homem, fala aos anciãos de Israel. Dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Vocês vieram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consultar? Tão certo como eu vivo, não deixarei que vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consultem, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.R: Filho do homem, fala aos anciãos de Israel. Dize-lhes: É isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Vocês vieram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pedir uma mensagem? Tão certo como eu vivo, não vou responder a vocês, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.

fr.L: Fils d’homme, parle aux anciens d’Israël et dis-leur : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Est-ce pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consulter que vous venez ? [Aussi vrai que] je suis vivant, je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} laisserai pas consulter par vous, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Fils d’homme, parle aux anciens d’Israël. Dis-leur : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Êtes-vous venus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consulter ? Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} laisserai pas consulter par vous, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, parle aux anciens d’Israël. Dis-leur : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Êtes-vous venus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demander un message ? Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, je ne vous répondrai pas, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Hijo de hombre, habla a los ancianos de Israel y diles: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: ¿Es para consultar{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} que {{plural_you:vienen|venís}}? Vivo yo, que no seré consultado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Hijo de hombre, habla a los ancianos de Israel. Diles: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: ¿{{plural_you:Han venido|Habéis venido}} a consultar{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? Tan cierto como que yo vivo, que no {{plural_you:les|os}} permitiré consultar{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, habla a los ancianos de Israel. Diles: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: ¿{{plural_you:Han venido|Habéis venido}} a pedir{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} un mensaje? Tan cierto como que yo vivo, que no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderé, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Hỡi con người, hãy nói với các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên và bảo chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Có phải các ngươi đến để cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chăng? [Thật như] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không để cho các ngươi cầu hỏi, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Hỡi con người, hãy nói với các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy bảo chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Các ngươi đến để cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không để các ngươi cầu hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đâu, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Hỡi con người, hãy nói với các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy bảo chúng: Đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Các ngươi đến để xin {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một sứ điệp sao? Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không trả lời các ngươi đâu, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

sw.L: Mwana wa binadamu, sema na wazee wa Israeli, uwaambie, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Je, ni kuniuliza {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiko mnakokuja? [Kama] niishivyo, sitaulizwa na ninyi, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mwana wa binadamu, sema na wazee wa Israeli. Waambie, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Je, mmekuja kuniuliza shauri? Hakika kama niishivyo, sitawaacha mniulize shauri, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, sema na wazee wa Israeli. Waambie, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Je, mmekuja kuniomba niwape ujumbe? Hakika kama niishivyo, sitawajibu, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 사람의 아들아, 이스라엘의 장로들에게 말하고 그들에게 일러라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 나에게 물으려고 온 것이냐? 내가 살아 있음을 [두고 맹세한다]. 나는 너희의 물음에 응하지 않겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 사람의 아들아, 이스라엘의 장로들에게 말하여라. 그들에게 일러라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 내 뜻을 물으려고 왔느냐? 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 나는 너희가 내 뜻을 묻게 하지 않겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 사람의 아들아, 이스라엘의 장로들에게 말하여라. 그들에게 전하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희가 내 말을 들으려고 왔느냐? 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 나는 너희에게 대답하지 않겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

am.L: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ለእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ተናገር፤ እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔን ልትጠይቁ ነውን የመጣችሁት? ሕያው ነኝና፣ በእናንተ አልጠየቅም፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ለእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ተናገር፤ እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔን ለመጠየቅ መጥታችኋልን? በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ እንድትጠይቁኝ አልፈቅድም፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ለእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ተናገር። እንዲህ በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ከእኔ መልእክት ለመጠየቅ መጥታችኋልን? በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ አልመልስላችሁም፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, इस्राएल के पुरनियों से बात करो और उनसे कहो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: क्या तुम मुझसे पूछने आए हो? मेरे जीवन की शपथ, मैं तुम्हें अपने से पूछने न दूँगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, इस्राएल के बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों से बात करो। उनसे कहो: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: क्या तुम मुझसे पूछने आए हो? मेरे जीवन की शपथ, मैं तुम्हें अपने से पूछने न दूँगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, इस्राएल के बुज़ुर्ग अगुवों से बात करो। उनसे कहो कि प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: क्या तुम मुझसे संदेश पूछने आए हो? मैं अपने जीवन की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ, मैं तुम्हें उत्तर नहीं दूँगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Сын человеческий, говори со старейшинами Израиля и скажи им: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Не для того ли, чтобы вопросить {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, вы приходите? Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, не дам {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вам вопрошать {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Сын человеческий, говори со старейшинами Израиля. Скажи им: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вы пришли вопросить {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}? Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, не позволю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вам вопрошать {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Сын человеческий, поговори со старейшинами Израиля. Скажи им: Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вы пришли, чтобы спросить {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} о {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} воле? Клянусь своей жизнью, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не отвечу вам, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 人の子よ、イスラエルの長老たちに語り、彼らに言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたは、わたしに伺いを立てるために来たのか？わたしは生きている。わたしは決して、あなたがたの伺いには応じない――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: 人の子よ、イスラエルの長老たちに語りなさい。彼らに言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたは、わたしに伺いを立てに来たのか？わたしは生きている。わたしは、あなたがたの伺いに応じはしない、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: 人よ、イスラエルの長老たちに語りなさい。彼らに言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたたちは、わたしの言葉を聞こうとして来たのか？わたしは生きている。そのわたしが誓って言う。わたしは、あなたたちに答えはしない、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Сину людський, говори до старійшин Ізраїлю і скажи їм: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Чи питати {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} ви приходите? Як {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не дам вам питати {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Сину людський, говори до старійшин Ізраїлю. Скажи їм: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Чи ви прийшли спитати в {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} поради? Як {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не дам вам питати {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Сину людський, говори до старійшин Ізраїлю. Скажи їм: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Чи ви прийшли попросити в {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} вістки? Як {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не відповім вам, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: son of man: a human being, a mortal addressed by God
decisions.reason: This is how God addresses Ezekiel throughout the book. It means "human being" and stresses that the prophet is a mortal before God; see the note at 2:1.

decisions.choice: As I live: an oath by God's own life
decisions.reason: God swears by his own life, the surest oath there is (Numbers 14:21, 28; Deuteronomy 32:40). The same oath closes the answer in verse 31 and opens the threat of verse 33.

decisions.choice: I will not be inquired of by you: God refuses to give these elders an answer
decisions.reason: The verb form means "let myself be sought" or "answer when sought". God refused in the same way in 14:3, because the elders had set up idols in their hearts. Here the reason is the history of rebellion that the chapter sets out, which, God says, they are still repeating (verses 30-31).

decisions.choice: consult (B); ask for a message (R)
decisions.reason: "Inquire of" is kept at Literal. Balanced and Readable use everyday words for coming to a prophet for God's answer (verse 1, m2). Readable says "I will not answer you", which is what the refusal means. The oath "As I live" is "As surely as I live" at Balanced and Readable, as in Jeremiah 22:24.

decisions.choice: hijo de hombre, lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel means 'human being, mortal'. Spanish keeps the plain wording 'hijo de hombre' at every level, Readable included, and never 'Hijo del Hombre', the Gospels' title of Jesus; Revelation 1:13 likewise has 'un hijo de hombre'.

decisions.choice: Así dice el Señor DIOS (L), El Señor DIOS dice esto (B), Esto es lo que dice el Señor DIOS (R); declara (L), afirma (B), dice (R); Vivo yo (L), Tan cierto como que yo vivo (B, R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic formulas follow Spanish Isaiah and Jeremiah, with 'el Señor' outside the divine_name span and DIOS / Yahvé inside it. The oath 'As I live' is worded as Isaiah 49:18. The elders are addressed in the plural, so every 'you' takes a plural_you span.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi con người", lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel (ben-adam) means "human being", and "con người" is the ordinary Vietnamese word for that, so the sense comes through without a gloss. It is kept lowercase so that it is never read as "Con Người", Jesus' title in the Gospels. Used for every "son of man" in Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA" for Adonai YHWH, with the formulas "Chúa là CHÚA phán thế này:" (L) / "phán như vầy:" (B) / "Đây là lời Chúa là CHÚA phán:" (R) and "Chúa là CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B) / "Chúa là CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: As published in Isaiah 28:16: "Chúa" (Adonai) is plain text and the divine name is the setting span. "Thật như Ta hằng sống" for God's oath follows Jeremiah 22:24, with "[Thật như]" bracketed at Literal.

decisions.choice: 사람의 아들아, at every level
decisions.reason: Ben-adam is God's address to Ezekiel: "human being, mortal". Korean keeps the plain 사람의 아들 at every level, so that it is never read as 인자, Jesus's title in the Korean New Testament; no gender span, since Ezekiel is one man. 인자야, the older Protestant wording, is the alternative. As at 2:1.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다 (L), 이렇게 말씀하신다 (B), 께서 하시는 말씀이다 (R), ending in a period; declares the Lord GOD: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다 (L), 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다 (B, R), as its own sentence
decisions.reason: 하나님 ends in a consonant and 야훼 in a vowel, so no particle that changes form (가, 는, 를) may follow the span; the term sheet's forms use only 께서, 의 and 이다. In God's own mouth "Thus says" keeps 께서, as the published prophets do. Recorded once for chapters 19-24.

decisions.choice: "mwana wa binadamu", lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel means "human being". The term sheet keeps the phrase at every level, as the English does, and keeps it apart from Jesus' title "Mwana wa Adamu" by its lowercase and its wording. A reviewer may prefer the everyday "mwanadamu" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Bwana MUNGU asema hivi:" (L); "Hivi ndivyo Bwana MUNGU asemavyo:" (B); "Hili ndilo Bwana MUNGU analosema:" (R); "asema Bwana MUNGU" (L, B), "anasema Bwana MUNGU" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's formulas for Adonai YHWH, with the divine_name span on MUNGU only, as in Isaiah. Used through this block of chapters.

decisions.choice: "[Kama] niishivyo" (L); "Hakika kama niishivyo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath by God's life as Swahili Jeremiah 22:24 words it.

decisions.choice: "fils d'homme" at every level, lowercase, without article and without a gender span
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel, a mortal; "le Fils de l'homme" is Jesus' title in the French New Testament and is kept apart. As the English decision at 2:1.

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle le Seigneur DIEU :" (L), "Le Seigneur DIEU dit ceci :" (B), "Voici ce que dit le Seigneur DIEU :" (R); "déclare" (L, B) / "dit" (R) le Seigneur DIEU; "Aussi vrai que je suis vivant", for the whole book
decisions.reason: The prophetic formulas as settled for French Isaiah and Jeremiah; the oath as in Samuel, with "Aussi vrai que" in brackets at L.

decisions.choice: "Son of man" "የሰው ልጅ ሆይ" at every level
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel terms list's address. Here, as the meaning decision says, it calls Ezekiel a mortal, a human being before God; it is not the New Testament title "የሰው ልጅ", though the Amharic words are the same, as the English keeps "Son of man" at every level.

decisions.choice: "Thus says the Lord GOD" "ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦" at every level, with no quotation marks around the words that follow
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel terms list's formula. The English sets the LORD's words in this chapter without quotation marks (only the words God quotes are marked), and the Amharic follows it.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उन्होंने).

decisions.choice: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान; प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं (L), यह कहते हैं (B, R); मेरे जीवन की शपथ (L, B), मैं अपने जीवन की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's formulas keep the forms of the earlier chapters: the address हे मनुष्य की सन्तान at every level, kept apart from Jesus' title मनुष्य का पुत्र; "Thus says the Lord GOD" as the prophets note; the oath "As I live" as Ezekiel 5:11 and 18:3. Balanced and Readable say the LORD will not let them consult him, or will not answer (m3).

decisions.choice: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (L, B); Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's wording for "Thus says the Lord GOD", as the Russian Ezekiel 11-14: "Владыка" for Adonai, the divine name in its setting.

decisions.choice: Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} (L, B); Клянусь своей жизнью (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's oath (m2) in the wording the Russian Ezekiel uses at 14:16-20 and 18:3.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не отвечу вам
decisions.reason: Readable says what the refusal means (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'iddaresh lakhem (negative oath) "決して、あなたがたの伺いには応じない" (L), "伺いに応じはしない" (B), "答えはしない" (R); ne'um at the end of the oath here, as the Hebrew; the same in 20:31.
decisions.reason: m3: God refuses to answer; the oath forms of the Ezekiel convention.

source.text: הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֹתָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֖וֹט בֶּן־אָדָ֑ם אֶת־תּוֹעֲבֹ֥ת אֲבוֹתָ֖ם הוֹדִיעֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Will you judge them, will you judge, son of man? [The] abominations of their fathers make known to them.

en.L: Will you judge them? Will you judge, son of man? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers.
en.B: Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then make them see the detestable practices of their {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}.
en.R: Son of man, are you ready to judge them? Then make them face the disgusting things their {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} did.

pt.L: Vais julgá-los? Vais julgar, filho do homem? Faze-os conhecer as abominações dos seus pais.
pt.B: Vais julgá-los? Vais julgá-los, filho do homem? Então faze-os ver as práticas detestáveis dos seus {{gender:antepassados|pais}}.
pt.R: Filho do homem, estás pronto para julgá-los? Então faze-os encarar as coisas repugnantes que os seus {{gender:antepassados|pais}} fizeram.

fr.L: Les jugeras-tu ? Jugeras-tu, fils d’homme ? Fais-leur connaître les abominations de leurs pères.
fr.B: Veux-tu les juger ? Veux-tu les juger, fils d’homme ? Alors mets-les en face des pratiques détestables de leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, es-tu prêt à les juger ? Alors mets-les en face des choses dégoûtantes que leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} ont faites.

es.L: ¿Los juzgarás? ¿Juzgarás, hijo de hombre? Hazles conocer las abominaciones de sus padres.
es.B: ¿Vas a juzgarlos? ¿Vas a juzgarlos, hijo de hombre? Entonces haz que vean las prácticas detestables de sus antepasados.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, ¿estás dispuesto a juzgarlos? Entonces haz que se enfrenten a las cosas repugnantes que hicieron sus antepasados.

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ xét xử chúng chăng? Ngươi sẽ xét xử chăng, hỡi con người? Hãy cho chúng biết những điều ghê tởm của tổ phụ chúng.
vi.B: Con có xét xử chúng không? Hỡi con người, con có xét xử chúng không? Vậy hãy cho chúng thấy những việc làm ghê tởm của tổ tiên chúng.
vi.R: Hỡi con người, con đã sẵn sàng xét xử chúng chưa? Vậy hãy bắt chúng đối diện với những việc ghê tởm mà tổ tiên chúng đã làm.

sw.L: Je, utawahukumu? Je, utahukumu, mwana wa binadamu? Wajulishe machukizo ya baba zao.
sw.B: Je, utawahukumu? Je, utawahukumu, mwana wa binadamu? Basi wafanye wayaone matendo ya kuchukiza ya babu zao.
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, je, uko tayari kuwahukumu? Basi wafanye wakabiliane na mambo ya kinyaa ambayo babu zao walifanya.

ko.L: 네가 그들을 심판하겠느냐? 사람의 아들아, 네가 심판하겠느냐? 그들의 조상들의 가증한 일들을 그들에게 알게 하여라.
ko.B: 네가 그들을 심판하겠느냐? 사람의 아들아, 네가 그들을 심판하겠느냐? 그렇다면 그들의 조상들이 저지른 역겨운 짓들을 그들이 깨닫게 하여라.
ko.R: 사람의 아들아, 그들을 심판할 준비가 되었느냐? 그렇다면 그들의 조상들이 저지른 역겨운 일들을 그들이 똑바로 보게 하여라.

am.L: ትፈርድባቸዋለህን? የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ትፈርድባቸዋለህን? የአባቶቻቸውን አስጸያፊ ነገሮች አስታውቃቸው።
am.B: ትፈርድባቸዋለህን? የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ትፈርድባቸዋለህን? እንግዲያስ {{gender:የቅድመ አያቶቻቸውን|የአባቶቻቸውን}} አስጸያፊ ነገሮች እንዲያዩ አድርጋቸው።
am.R: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ልትፈርድባቸው ተዘጋጅተሃልን? እንግዲያስ {{gender:ቅድመ አያቶቻቸው|አባቶቻቸው}} ያደረጓቸውን አስጸያፊ ነገሮች ፊት ለፊት እንዲጋፈጡ አድርጋቸው።

hi.L: क्या तुम उनका न्याय करोगे? हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, क्या तुम न्याय करोगे? उनके पुरखाओं के घृणित काम उन्हें बताओ।
hi.B: क्या तुम उनका न्याय करोगे? हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, क्या तुम उनका न्याय करोगे? तो उन्हें उनके {{gender:पूर्वजों|पितरों}} की घृणित प्रथाएँ दिखाओ।
hi.R: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, क्या तुम उनका न्याय करने को तैयार हो? तो उन्हें उन घिनौने कामों का सामना कराओ जो उनके {{gender:पूर्वजों|पितरों}} ने किए थे।

ru.L: Будешь ли судить их, будешь ли судить, сын человеческий? Мерзости их отцов дай им знать.
ru.B: Будешь ли ты судить их? Будешь ли судить, сын человеческий? Тогда покажи им мерзкие дела их {{gender:предков|отцов}}.
ru.R: Сын человеческий, готов ли ты судить их? Тогда заставь их увидеть, какие отвратительные дела совершали их {{gender:предки|отцы}}.

ja.L: あなたは彼らを裁くのか？人の子よ、あなたは裁くのか？彼らの父祖たちの忌み嫌うべきことを、彼らに知らせなさい。
ja.B: あなたは彼らを裁くのか？人の子よ、彼らを裁くのか？それなら、彼らの先祖の忌まわしい行いを、彼らに分からせなさい。
ja.R: 人よ、あなたは彼らを裁く用意ができているか？それなら、彼らの先祖がしたひどく汚らわしいことに、彼らを向き合わせなさい。

uk.L: Чи судитимеш ти їх? Чи судитимеш, сину людський? Обʼяви їм гидоти їхніх батьків.
uk.B: Чи судитимеш ти їх? Чи судитимеш ти їх, сину людський? Тоді покажи їм огидні звичаї їхніх предків.
uk.R: Сину людський, чи готовий ти судити їх? Тоді постав їх віч-на-віч з огидними речами, які робили їхні предки.

decisions.choice: Will you judge them?: a call to bring the charge against them, in effect a command
alternatives: a question asking whether Ezekiel is willing to plead for them
decisions.reason: The repeated question invites the prophet to act as the one who states the case against the people, and the command that follows says how: by telling them what their ancestors did. Ezekiel is asked the same thing about Jerusalem in 22:2 and about Oholah and Oholibah in 23:36.

decisions.choice: abominations: practices the LORD finds detestable, above all idol worship
decisions.reason: The word is used throughout Ezekiel for idolatry and the acts that go with it (5:9, 11; 8:6). Verses 5-31 now list them, from Egypt to Ezekiel's own day.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the earlier generations of the people, women as well as men, so Balanced and Readable say "ancestors", with "fathers" as the reader's alternative. Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: abominaciones (L); prácticas detestables (B); cosas repugnantes (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's word to'evah is worded as in Spanish 2 Kings 21:2 at each level, and kept apart from the word for vile idols (shiqqutsim).

decisions.choice: sus padres (L); sus antepasados (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish 'padres' and 'antepasados' already include women, so no gender span is needed where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "điều ghê tởm" (L) / "việc làm ghê tởm" (B) / "việc ghê tởm" (R) for to'evah
decisions.reason: The term sheet's book-wide wording for to'evah, as Deuteronomy 18:12.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (L) / "tổ tiên" (B, R) with no gender span; "con cái" for children/sons likewise
decisions.reason: "Tổ tiên" and "con cái" already include men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the English gender setting to switch to, as in Isaiah and Jeremiah. Applies through these chapters.

decisions.choice: to'evah: 가증한 일 (L), 역겨운 짓 (B), 역겨운 일 (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for "abominations", as Deuteronomy 18:12 and 2 Kings 16:3 publish it.

decisions.choice: 조상들, with no gender span, where the English has {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}
decisions.reason: Korean 조상 already means forebears of both sexes, as Jeremiah has it (Jer 7:25); "sons" meaning children keeps the span {{gender:자녀들|아들들}}.

decisions.choice: "machukizo" (L); "matendo ya kuchukiza" (B); "mambo ya kinyaa" (R) for to'evah
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, as Deuteronomy 18:12; used through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "baba zao" (L); "babu zao" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English has a gender span on ancestors/fathers or children/sons, Swahili "babu", "watoto" and "wana" already cover both sexes, so the Swahili has no span and the setting has nothing to change. This holds for the rest of these chapters.

decisions.choice: "abominations" (L); "pratiques détestables" (B); "choses dégoûtantes" (R) for *to'evah*, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The French wording of Deuteronomy 18:12, settled for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: {{gender:antepassados|pais}}
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): "pais" here is the earlier generations, and Portuguese has the same choice the English has, "antepassados" or the traditional "pais", as Jeremiah 3:18 sets it; Literal keeps "pais".

decisions.choice: "Ancestors" as {{gender:ቅድመ አያቶቻቸው|አባቶቻቸው}}, with the prefix inside each option
decisions.reason: The form docs/amharic-style.md proposes for the English ancestors/fathers span; used through this chapter wherever the English has it.

decisions.choice: पुरखा (L); {{gender:पूर्वज|पितर}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where the English has an ancestors / fathers span, Balanced and Readable use the span Judges 2:17 has in Hindi (पूर्वज / पितर). Literal, where the English has plain "fathers" meaning the forebears, says पुरखा, as Ezekiel 2:3.

decisions.choice: घृणित काम (L); घृणित प्रथाएँ (B); घिनौने काम (R)
decisions.reason: Abominations (to'evot) take the forms of Ezekiel 11:18 and chapter 18.

decisions.choice: {{gender:предков|отцов}}
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the earlier generations of the people, so Balanced and Readable say "предки" with "отцы" as the alternative, as the English does; Literal keeps "отцы".

decisions.choice: мерзости (L); мерзкие дела (B); отвратительные дела (R)
decisions.reason: To'evah in the wording of 18:12.

decisions.choice: 'avot "父祖たち" (L), "先祖" (B, R) with no gender span: 先祖 is already inclusive, so the English span ancestors / fathers is not needed (20:4, 18, 24, 27, 30, 36, 42).
decisions.reason: Style §7 (no span where Japanese is inclusive); the NEH / 1CO forms for 'avot.

decisions.choice: "предки" with no gender span for {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}
decisions.reason: As at 5:10: Ukrainian "предки" and "батьки" both take in men and women, so the span would change nothing; Literal keeps "батьки". Kept through the book.

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּיוֹם֙ בָּחֳרִ֣י בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וָאֶשָּׂ֣א יָדִ֗י לְזֶ֨רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וָאִוָּדַ֥ע לָהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֨א יָדִ֤י לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And say to them, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: On [the] day of my choosing Israel, and I lifted my hand to [the] seed of [the] house of Jacob, and I made myself known to them in [the] land of Egypt, and I lifted my hand to them, saying, I [am] Yahweh your God.

en.L: And say to them, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: On the day when I chose Israel, I lifted {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand to the seed of the house of Jacob, and I made {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} known to them in the land of Egypt; I lifted {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand to them, saying, "I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.B: Say to them, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: On the day I chose Israel, I raised {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand in an oath to the offspring of Jacob's house and made {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} known to them in the land of Egypt. I raised {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand in an oath to them and said, "I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.R: Tell them, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: When I chose Israel, I made a solemn promise to the people of Jacob's family. I showed them who I am while they were in Egypt. I promised them with an oath, "I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."

pt.L: E dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: No dia em que escolhi Israel, levantei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão para a descendência da casa de Jacó e {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dei a conhecer a eles na terra do Egito; levantei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão para eles, dizendo: "Eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus."
pt.B: Dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: No dia em que escolhi Israel, levantei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão em juramento à descendência da casa de Jacó e {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dei a conhecer a eles na terra do Egito. Levantei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão em juramento a eles e disse: "Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus."
pt.R: Dize-lhes: É isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Quando escolhi Israel, fiz uma promessa solene ao povo da família de Jacó. Eu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mostrei a eles quando estavam no Egito. Prometi a eles com juramento: "Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus."

fr.L: Et dis-leur : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Le jour où j’ai choisi Israël, j’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main vers la descendance de la maison de Jacob, et je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis fait connaître à eux au pays d’Égypte ; j’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main vers eux, en disant : « Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. »
fr.B: Dis-leur : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Le jour où j’ai choisi Israël, j’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main pour prêter serment à la descendance de la maison de Jacob, et je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis fait connaître à eux au pays d’Égypte. J’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main pour leur faire ce serment : « Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. »
fr.R: Dis-leur : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Quand j’ai choisi Israël, j’ai fait une promesse solennelle aux descendants de la famille de Jacob. Je leur ai montré qui je suis quand ils étaient en Égypte. Je leur ai promis par serment : « Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. »

es.L: Y diles: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: El día en que escogí a Israel, alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano a la descendencia de la casa de Jacob, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} di a conocer a ellos en la tierra de Egipto; alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano a ellos, diciendo: «Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.B: Diles: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: El día en que escogí a Israel, alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano en juramento ante la descendencia de la casa de Jacob y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} di a conocer a ellos en la tierra de Egipto. Alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano en juramento ante ellos y les dije: «Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.R: Diles: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Cuando escogí a Israel, hice una promesa solemne al pueblo de la familia de Jacob. Les mostré quién soy yo cuando estaban en Egipto. Les prometí con juramento: «Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».

vi.L: và bảo chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chọn Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giơ tay thề với dòng dõi nhà Gia-cốp, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tỏ mình cho họ biết tại xứ Ai Cập; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giơ tay thề với họ mà phán: "Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi."
vi.B: Hãy bảo chúng: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chọn Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giơ tay thề với dòng dõi nhà Gia-cốp và tỏ mình cho họ biết tại xứ Ai Cập. Ta đã giơ tay thề với họ rằng: "Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi."
vi.R: Hãy bảo chúng: Đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chọn Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã long trọng thề với con cháu nhà Gia-cốp. Ta đã cho họ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai khi họ còn ở Ai Cập. Ta đã thề với họ: "Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi."

sw.L: Nawe uwaambie, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Siku nilipomchagua Israeli, niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa uzao wa nyumba ya Yakobo, nikajijulisha kwao katika nchi ya Misri; niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwao, nikisema, "Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."
sw.B: Waambie, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Siku ile nilipomchagua Israeli, niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuapa kwa wazao wa nyumba ya Yakobo, nikajijulisha kwao katika nchi ya Misri. Niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuwaapia, nikasema, "Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."
sw.R: Waambie, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nilipomchagua Israeli, niliwapa watu wa ukoo wa Yakobo ahadi kwa kiapo. Niliwaonyesha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani walipokuwa Misri. Niliwaahidi kwa kiapo, "Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."

ko.L: 그리고 그들에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 이스라엘을 택한 날에, 나는 야곱 집의 씨에게 내 손을 들었고, 이집트 땅에서 그들에게 나를 알렸으며, 그들에게 내 손을 들어 말했다. "나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희의 하나님이다."
ko.B: 그들에게 일러라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 이스라엘을 택하던 날, 나는 야곱 집의 자손에게 손을 들어 맹세하고, 이집트 땅에서 그들에게 나를 알렸다. 나는 그들에게 손을 들어 맹세하며 말했다. "나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다."
ko.R: 그들에게 전하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 이스라엘을 택했을 때, 나는 야곱 집안의 백성에게 굳게 약속했다. 그들이 이집트에 있을 때 나는 내가 누구인지 그들에게 보여 주었다. 나는 맹세하며 그들에게 약속했다. "나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다."

am.L: እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እስራኤልን በመረጥኩበት ቀን ለያዕቆብ ቤት ዘር እጄን አነሣሁ፤ በግብፅ ምድርም ራሴን ገለጥኩላቸው፤ እጄንም አንሥቼላቸው፦ «እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]» አልኳቸው።
am.B: እንዲህ በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እስራኤልን በመረጥኩበት ቀን እጄን አንሥቼ ለያዕቆብ ቤት ዘር ማልኩ፤ በግብፅ ምድርም ራሴን ገለጥኩላቸው። እጄን አንሥቼ ማልኩላቸው፤ «እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ» አልኳቸው።
am.R: እንዲህ በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እስራኤልን በመረጥኩ ጊዜ ለያዕቆብ ቤተሰብ ሕዝብ በመሐላ ቃል ገባሁ። በግብፅ ሳሉ ማን እንደ ሆንኩ አሳየኋቸው። «እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ» ብዬ በመሐላ ቃል ገባሁላቸው።

hi.L: और उनसे कहो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: जिस दिन मैंने इस्राएल को चुना, मैंने याकूब के घराने के वंश के लिए अपना हाथ उठाया, और मिस्र देश में अपने आप को उन पर प्रगट किया; मैंने उनके लिए अपना हाथ उठाकर कहा, "मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ]।"
hi.B: उनसे कहो: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जिस दिन मैंने इस्राएल को चुना, मैंने याकूब के घराने के वंश से हाथ उठाकर शपथ खाई, और मिस्र देश में अपने आप को उन पर प्रगट किया। मैंने हाथ उठाकर उनसे शपथ खाई और कहा, "मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ।"
hi.R: उनसे कहो कि प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: जब मैंने इस्राएल को चुना, तब मैंने याकूब के परिवार के लोगों से शपथ खाकर एक वचन दिया। जब वे मिस्र में थे, तब मैंने उन्हें दिखाया कि मैं कौन हूँ। मैंने शपथ खाकर उनसे कहा, "मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ।"

ru.L: И скажи им: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: В день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} избрал Израиль, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поднял {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку к потомству дома Иакова и дал себя знать им в земле Египта; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поднял {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку к ним, говоря: «Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.»
ru.B: Скажи им: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: В тот день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} избрал Израиль, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поднял руку в клятве потомкам дома Иакова и открыл себя им в земле Египта. Я поднял руку в клятве и сказал им: «Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.»
ru.R: Скажи им: Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} избрал Израиль, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дал торжественное обещание потомкам Иакова. Я показал им, кто {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, когда они были в Египте. Я с клятвой обещал им: «Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.»

ja.L: そして彼らに言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしがイスラエルを選んだ日に、わたしはヤコブの家の子孫に手を上げて[誓い]、エジプトの地で彼らにわたし自身を知らせ、彼らに手を上げて[誓って]言った。「わたしはあなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」
ja.B: 彼らに言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしがイスラエルを選んだ日、わたしはヤコブの家の子孫に手を上げて誓い、エジプトの地で彼らにわたし自身を知らせた。わたしは彼らに手を上げて誓い、言った。「わたしはあなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」
ja.R: 彼らに言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしはイスラエルを選んだとき、ヤコブの一族の人々に固く約束した。彼らがエジプトにいたとき、わたしは、自分がだれであるかを彼らに示した。わたしは誓って、彼らに約束した。「わたしはあなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」

uk.L: І скажи їм: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: У день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вибрав Ізраїля, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} підніс свою руку до нащадків дому Якова і дав себе пізнати їм у землі Єгипту; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} підніс свою руку до них, кажучи: «Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.»
uk.B: Скажи їм: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: У день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вибрав Ізраїля, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} підніс руку в присязі нащадкам дому Якова і обʼявив себе їм у землі Єгипту. Я підніс руку в присязі до них і сказав: «Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.»
uk.R: Скажи їм: Так говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вибрав Ізраїля, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} урочисто пообіцяв нащадкам родини Якова. Я показав їм, хто {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, коли вони були в Єгипті. Я пообіцяв їм із присягою: «Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.»

decisions.choice: I lifted my hand: I swore an oath
decisions.reason: Raising the hand was the gesture of swearing (Genesis 14:22; Deuteronomy 32:40). Exodus 6:8 uses the same words for God's oath to give the land to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. The phrase runs through the chapter: God swears to bring Israel out (verse 6), later swears that the rebels will not enter the land (verse 15) and that he will scatter them (verse 23), and keeps his oath to the ancestors (verses 28 and 42).

decisions.choice: "I am the LORD your God": the words of God's self-revelation in Egypt
decisions.reason: In Egypt God told Moses to say to Israel, "I am the LORD", and promised, "I will be your God" (Exodus 6:2-8); the Ten Commandments open with "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt" (Exodus 20:2). Ezekiel retells that moment as the start of Israel's story with God.

decisions.choice: chose: God's choice of Israel as his people
decisions.reason: This is the only place where Ezekiel says that God "chose" Israel. The word recalls Deuteronomy, where God chose Israel out of all peoples because he loved them (Deuteronomy 7:6-8).

decisions.choice: raised my hand in an oath (B); made a solemn promise, promised with an oath (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the gesture. Balanced names it as an oath the first time and says "swore" after that; Readable says "promised with an oath", the wording of Exodus 6:8 at Readable.

decisions.choice: alcé mi mano (L); alcé mi mano en juramento (B); hice una promesa solemne, prometí con juramento (R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the gesture of the oath; B adds 'en juramento', as Spanish Numbers 14:30 B; R says plainly that God swore. The same wording is used through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "giơ tay thề" (L, B) / "long trọng thề" (R); "họ" for the ancestors through the history of verses 5-29
decisions.reason: "Giơ tay" alone does not say "swear" in Vietnamese; "giơ tay thề" is the published Literal form (Exodus 6:8). The elders now addressed are "chúng" (Israel under judgment); their ancestors in the history are "họ", so the two groups stay apart.

decisions.choice: 손을 들다 (L); 손을 들어 맹세하다 (B); 굳게 약속하다, 맹세하며 약속하다 (R)
decisions.reason: As Numbers 14:30 in Korean: Literal keeps the gesture, Balanced keeps it and names the oath, Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans: God's "me" and "my" are 나 and 내 in his own 해라체 speech
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have nothing to change in Korean (style guide 7); God names himself without -시-.

decisions.choice: "niliinua mkono wangu" (L); "niliinua mkono wangu kuapa" (B); "niliahidi kwa kiapo" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the gesture and names the oath; Readable states the oath only. The same wording returns in verses 6, 15, 23, 28 and 42.

decisions.choice: God's retelling of Israel's history (20:5-29) in the passé composé at every level ("j'ai choisi", "ils se sont révoltés")
alternatives: passé simple at L and B
decisions.reason: It is spoken by God through the prophet, so it keeps the tenses of speech, as the retellings of history in Acts and the oracles of Isaiah and Jeremiah do.

decisions.choice: "j'ai levé ma main vers" (L); "j'ai levé ma main pour prêter serment" (B); "j'ai fait une promesse solennelle", "j'ai promis par serment" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the gesture and names the oath, as the English "raised my hand in an oath"; Readable says only what it means.

decisions.choice: levantei a minha mão (L); levantei a minha mão em juramento (B), then "jurei" (verses 6, 15, 23, 28, 42); fiz uma promessa solene, prometi com juramento (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and as Exodus 6:8 has the gesture in Portuguese ("levantei a minha mão"): Literal keeps it through the chapter; Balanced names the oath the first time and then says "jurei"; Readable says "prometi com juramento".

decisions.choice: "I lifted my hand": L "እጄን አነሣሁ" (Exodus 6:8); B "እጄን አንሥቼ ማልኩ"; R "በመሐላ ቃል ገባሁ"; the same in verses 6, 15, 23, 28, 42
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the gesture as Exodus 6:8 on main has it; Balanced names the oath, as the English "raised my hand in an oath"; Readable says "promised with an oath". "I am the LORD your God" as Leviticus on main: "እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]".

decisions.choice: अपना हाथ उठाया (L); हाथ उठाकर शपथ खाई (B); शपथ खाकर वचन दिया (R)
decisions.reason: Lifting the hand is the gesture of an oath (m1). The forms are those of Exodus 6:8 and Numbers 14:30: Literal keeps the gesture, Balanced names it, Readable says the promise. They hold for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: поднял {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку (L); поднял руку в клятве, поклялся (B); торжественно пообещал, с клятвой обещал (R)
decisions.reason: The raised hand is an oath (m1): Literal keeps the gesture, as the Russian Numbers 14:30; Balanced names the oath the first time and says "поклялся" after that; Readable says "с клятвой обещал", as the Russian Exodus 6:8 at Readable.

decisions.choice: nasa' yad "手を上げて[誓う]" (L), "手を上げて誓う" (B), "固く約束する" / "誓って約束する" (R), as EXO 6:8 and NUM 14:30, through ch. 20 (20:5, 6, 15, 23, 28, 42).
decisions.reason: m1: I swore an oath; the Pentateuch's Japanese for the same idiom.

decisions.choice: 'ani YHWH 'eloheikhem "わたしはあなたがたの神、主である" (R あなたたち), as EXO 6:7 and LEV; the same in 20:7, 19, 20.
decisions.reason: m2: the words of God's self-revelation.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נָשָׂ֤אתִי יָדִי֙ לָהֶ֔ם לְהֽוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל־אֶ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֗ם זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ צְבִ֥י הִ֖יא לְכָל־הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: On the day the that I lifted my hand to them to bring them out from [the] land of Egypt to a land that I had searched out for them, flowing [with] milk and honey; beauty it [is] to all the lands.

en.L: On that day I lifted {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt to a land that I had scouted out for them, flowing [with] milk and honey; it [is the] beauty of all the lands.
en.B: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land I had scouted out for them, flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.
en.R: That day I promised them with an oath that I would bring them out of Egypt. I would take them to a land I had chosen for them. It was a rich and fertile land, full of milk and honey, the most beautiful land of all.

pt.L: Naquele dia levantei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão para eles, para tirá-los da terra do Egito para uma terra que eu tinha explorado para eles, onde corre leite e mel; ela [é] a beleza de todas as terras,
pt.B: Naquele dia jurei a eles que os tiraria da terra do Egito para uma terra que eu tinha explorado para eles, onde corre leite e mel, a mais bela de todas as terras.
pt.R: Naquele dia prometi a eles com juramento que os tiraria do Egito. Eu os levaria para uma terra que eu tinha escolhido para eles. Era uma terra rica e fértil, cheia de leite e mel, a mais bonita de todas as terras.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, j’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main vers eux pour les faire sortir du pays d’Égypte vers un pays que j’avais exploré pour eux, ruisselant de lait et de miel ; c’[est] la beauté de tous les pays.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je leur ai juré de les faire sortir du pays d’Égypte pour les conduire dans un pays que j’avais exploré pour eux, ruisselant de lait et de miel, le plus beau de tous les pays.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, je leur ai promis par serment de les faire sortir d’Égypte. Je devais les conduire dans un pays que j’avais choisi pour eux. C’était un pays riche, plein de lait et de miel, le plus beau de tous les pays.

es.L: Aquel día alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano a ellos, para sacarlos de la tierra de Egipto a una tierra que yo había explorado para ellos, que fluye leche y miel; ella [es] la hermosura de todas las tierras.
es.B: Aquel día les juré que los sacaría de la tierra de Egipto y los llevaría a una tierra que yo había explorado para ellos, una tierra que fluye leche y miel, la más hermosa de todas las tierras.
es.R: Aquel día les prometí con juramento que los sacaría de Egipto. Los llevaría a una tierra que yo había escogido para ellos. Era una tierra rica y fértil, llena de leche y miel, la tierra más hermosa de todas.

vi.L: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giơ tay thề với họ rằng sẽ đem họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, đến một xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dò xét sẵn cho họ, xứ tràn đầy sữa và mật; ấy [là] vẻ đẹp của mọi xứ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề với họ rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, vào một xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tìm sẵn cho họ, xứ tràn đầy sữa và mật, xứ đẹp nhất trong mọi xứ.
vi.R: Ngày ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề với họ rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đưa họ ra khỏi Ai Cập. Ta sẽ dẫn họ đến một xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn cho họ. Đó là một xứ màu mỡ, tràn đầy sữa và mật, xứ đẹp nhất trong mọi xứ.

sw.L: Siku ile niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwao, kuwatoa katika nchi ya Misri mpaka nchi niliyokuwa nimewapelelezea, itiririkayo maziwa na asali; [ndiyo] uzuri wa nchi zote.
sw.B: Siku ile niliwaapia kwamba nitawatoa katika nchi ya Misri na kuwaleta katika nchi niliyokuwa nimewapelelezea, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, iliyo nzuri kuliko nchi zote.
sw.R: Siku ile niliwaahidi kwa kiapo kwamba nitawatoa Misri. Ningewapeleka katika nchi niliyokuwa nimewachagulia. Ilikuwa nchi tajiri yenye rutuba, iliyojaa maziwa na asali, nchi nzuri kuliko nchi zote.

ko.L: 그날에 나는 그들에게 내 손을 들어, 그들을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내어 내가 그들을 위하여 살펴 둔 땅, 젖과 꿀이 흐르는 땅으로 [데려가겠다고 했다]. 그 땅은 모든 땅의 아름다움이다.
ko.B: 그날 나는 그들을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내어, 내가 그들을 위해 미리 살펴 둔 땅, 젖과 꿀이 흐르는 땅, 모든 땅 가운데 가장 아름다운 땅으로 데려가겠다고 맹세했다.
ko.R: 그날 나는 그들을 이집트에서 이끌어 내겠다고 맹세하며 약속했다. 나는 그들을 위해 골라 둔 땅으로 그들을 데려가려고 했다. 그 땅은 기름지고 풍성하여 젖과 꿀이 넘쳐흘렀고, 모든 땅 가운데 가장 아름다운 땅이었다.

am.L: በዚያ ቀን ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣቸው ዘንድ፣ ለእነርሱም ወደ ሰለልኩላቸው ምድር፣ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስ ምድር [አገባቸው ዘንድ] እጄን አነሣሁላቸው፤ እርሷም የምድሮች ሁሉ ውበት [ናት]።
am.B: በዚያ ቀን ከግብፅ ምድር አውጥቼ ለእነርሱ ወደ ሰለልኩላቸው፣ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስ፣ ከምድሮች ሁሉ እጅግ ወደምታምር ምድር እንደማገባቸው ማልኩላቸው።
am.R: በዚያ ቀን ከግብፅ እንደማወጣቸው በመሐላ ቃል ገባሁላቸው። ለእነርሱ ወደ መረጥኩላቸው ምድር እወስዳቸው ነበር። እርሷ ለም ምድር፣ ወተትና ማር የሞላባት፣ ከምድሮች ሁሉ እጅግ ያማረች ምድር ነበረች።

hi.L: उसी दिन मैंने उनके लिए अपना हाथ उठाया कि उन्हें मिस्र देश से निकालकर उस देश में ले जाऊँ जिसे मैंने उनके लिए खोज रखा था, जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं; वह सब देशों की शोभा [है]।
hi.B: उस दिन मैंने उनसे शपथ खाई कि मैं उन्हें मिस्र देश से निकालकर ऐसे देश में ले जाऊँगा जिसे मैंने उनके लिए खोज रखा था, जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं, जो सब देशों में सबसे सुंदर है।
hi.R: उस दिन मैंने उन्हें शपथ खाकर वचन दिया कि मैं उन्हें मिस्र से निकाल लाऊँगा। मैं उन्हें ऐसे देश में ले जाऊँगा जिसे मैंने उनके लिए चुन रखा था। वह बहुत उपजाऊ देश था, ऐसा देश जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं, सब देशों में सबसे सुंदर।

ru.L: В тот день {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поднял {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку к ним, [поклявшись] вывести их из земли Египта в землю, которую {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} высмотрел для них, где течёт молоко и мёд; она — краса всех земель.
ru.B: В тот день {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поклялся им, что выведу их из земли Египта в землю, которую {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} высмотрел для них, в землю, где течёт молоко и мёд, прекраснейшую из всех земель.
ru.R: В тот день {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с клятвой обещал им, что выведу их из Египта. Я обещал привести их в землю, которую {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} выбрал для них. Это была богатая земля, где течёт молоко и мёд, самая прекрасная из всех земель.

ja.L: その日、わたしは彼らに手を上げて[誓った]。彼らをエジプトの地から導き出し、わたしが彼らのために探り出しておいた地、乳と蜜の流れる地に[導き入れる]と。それはすべての地の麗しさである。
ja.B: その日、わたしは彼らに誓った。エジプトの地から彼らを導き出し、わたしが彼らのために探っておいた地、乳と蜜の流れる地、すべての地の中で最も麗しい地に導き入れる、と。
ja.R: その日、わたしは、彼らをエジプトから連れ出すと固く約束した。わたしが彼らのために選んでおいた土地に連れて行く、と。それは、作物のよく実る豊かな土地で、乳と蜜があふれ、どの土地よりも美しい土地だった。

uk.L: Того дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} підніс свою руку до них, щоб вивести їх із землі Єгипту до землі, яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вишукав для них, що тече молоком і медом; вона — окраса всіх країв.
uk.B: Того дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} присягнув їм, що виведу їх із землі Єгипту до землі, яку {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вишукав для них, що тече молоком і медом, найкращої з усіх земель.
uk.R: Того дня {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пообіцяв їм із присягою, що виведу їх з Єгипту. Я мав привести їх до землі, яку вибрав для них. Це була багата й родюча земля, повна молока й меду, найкраща з усіх земель.

decisions.choice: scouted out: explored, as a scout explores a land
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the spies Moses sent to explore Canaan (Numbers 13:2, 16-17). Here God himself has explored the land in advance and picked it for Israel, as he went ahead of them "to scout out a place" for their camps (Deuteronomy 1:33).

decisions.choice: flowing with milk and honey: the promise of Exodus 3:8
decisions.reason: The phrase is the standard description of the promised land from God's first words to Moses (Exodus 3:8, 17). Milk points to good pasture for flocks, and honey to wild bees' honey or a syrup from fruit; together they picture a rich and fertile country.

decisions.choice: the beauty of all the lands: the finest land of all
decisions.reason: The word means beauty or splendor. Jeremiah 3:19 calls Israel's land "the most beautiful inheritance of the nations", and Daniel 8:9 and 11:16 call it "the beautiful land".

decisions.choice: a land I had chosen for them; a rich and fertile land, full of milk and honey
alternatives: a land I had scouted out for them, flowing with milk and honey
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's searching out meant for Israel, and uses the Readable wording of Exodus 3:8 for the milk and honey.

decisions.choice: onde corre leite e mel (L, B); cheia de leite e mel (R)
decisions.reason: The promise of Exodus 3:8 (m2) in the words the Old Testament terms and Exodus 3:8 give it in Portuguese, at each level.

decisions.choice: "flowing with milk and honey" "ወተትና ማር የምታፈስ"
decisions.reason: The words of Exodus 3:8, 17 on main, which this verse recalls; again in verse 15.

decisions.choice: जिसमें दूध और मधु की धाराएँ बहती हैं
decisions.reason: The promise of Exodus 3:8 (m2) keeps its Hindi wording at every level.

decisions.choice: где течёт молоко и мёд (L, B); богатая земля, где течёт молоко и мёд (R)
decisions.reason: The promise of Exodus 3:8 (m2) in the wording of the Russian Pentateuch at each level (Exodus 13:5).

decisions.choice: высмотрел
decisions.reason: The verb is that of the spies who explored Canaan (m1): "высмотреть" keeps the picture; Readable says "выбрал", as the English "chosen".

decisions.choice: zavat chalav udvash "乳と蜜の流れる地" (L, B), "乳と蜜があふれ" (R), as EXO 3:8; tsevi "麗しさ" (L), "最も麗しい" (B), "どの土地よりも美しい" (R); the same in 20:15.
decisions.reason: m2, m3: the Exodus promise in the Exodus Japanese.

source.text: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִ֣ישׁ שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵינָיו֙ הַשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וּבְגִלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם אַל־תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said to them, Each [man] the detestable things of his eyes throw away, and with [the] idols of Egypt do not defile yourselves; I [am] Yahweh your God.

en.L: And I said to them, "Each [of you], throw away the detestable things of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the filthy idols of Egypt; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.B: I said to them, "Every one of you must throw away the vile idols you look to, and do not make yourselves unclean with the idols of Egypt. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.R: I told them, "Each of you must throw away the disgusting idols you love to look at. Do not make yourselves unclean by worshiping the idols of Egypt. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."

pt.L: E eu lhes disse: "Cada um [de vocês] lance fora as coisas detestáveis dos seus olhos, e não se contaminem com os ídolos imundos do Egito; eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus."
pt.B: Eu lhes disse: "Cada um de vocês tem de jogar fora os ídolos vis para os quais olha, e não se tornem impuros com os ídolos do Egito. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus."
pt.R: Eu disse a eles: "Cada um de vocês tem de jogar fora os ídolos repugnantes que gosta de olhar. Não se tornem impuros adorando os ídolos do Egito. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus."

fr.L: Et je leur ai dit : « Que chacun [de vous] jette les choses détestables de ses yeux, et ne vous souillez pas avec les idoles immondes d’Égypte ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. »
fr.B: Je leur ai dit : « Que chacun de vous rejette les idoles abjectes vers lesquelles il tourne ses regards, et ne vous rendez pas impurs avec les idoles d’Égypte. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. »
fr.R: Je leur ai dit : « Que chacun de vous jette les idoles dégoûtantes qu’il aime tant regarder. Ne vous rendez pas impurs en adorant les idoles d’Égypte. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. »

es.L: Y les dije: «Cada uno arroje las cosas detestables de sus ojos, y no {{plural_you:se contaminen|os contaminéis}} con los ídolos inmundos de Egipto; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.B: Les dije: «Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe tirar los ídolos viles en que pone los ojos, y no {{plural_you:se contaminen|os contaminéis}} con los ídolos de Egipto. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.R: Les dije: «Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tiene que tirar los ídolos repugnantes que le gusta mirar. No {{plural_you:se hagan impuros|os hagáis impuros}} adorando a los ídolos de Egipto. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán với họ: "Mỗi người [trong các ngươi], hãy ném bỏ các vật đáng ghê tởm của mắt mình, và đừng làm ô uế mình với các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của Ai Cập; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi."
vi.B: Ta đã phán với họ: "Mỗi người trong các ngươi phải ném bỏ các thần tượng gớm ghiếc mà mắt mình chiêm ngưỡng, và đừng làm cho mình ô uế bởi các thần tượng của Ai Cập. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi."
vi.R: Ta đã phán với họ: "Mỗi người trong các ngươi phải ném bỏ những thần tượng ghê tởm mà các ngươi thích ngắm nhìn. Đừng làm cho mình ô uế bằng cách thờ lạy các thần tượng của Ai Cập. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi."

sw.L: Nami nikawaambia, "Kila mtu atupilie mbali vitu vya kuchukiza vya macho yake, wala msijitie unajisi kwa sanamu chafu za Misri; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."
sw.B: Nikawaambia, "Kila mmoja wenu na azitupilie mbali sanamu za kuchukiza anazozitazamia, wala msijitie unajisi kwa sanamu za Misri. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."
sw.R: Niliwaambia, "Kila mmoja wenu azitupe sanamu za kuchukiza anazopenda kuzitazama. Msijitie unajisi kwa kuabudu sanamu za Misri. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu."

ko.L: 그리고 나는 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 각자 자기 눈의 혐오스러운 것들을 던져 버리고, 이집트의 더러운 우상들로 너희 자신을 더럽히지 마라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희의 하나님이다."
ko.B: 나는 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 저마다 눈길을 두고 있는 역겨운 우상들을 던져 버리고, 이집트의 우상들로 너희 자신을 더럽히지 마라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다."
ko.R: 나는 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 저마다 즐겨 바라보는 더러운 우상들을 내버려라. 이집트의 우상들을 섬겨서 너희 자신을 더럽히지 마라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다."

am.L: እንዲህም አልኳቸው፦ «እያንዳንዳችሁ የዓይናችሁን ርኩሰቶች ጣሉ፤ በግብፅም ጣዖታት ራሳችሁን አታርክሱ፤ እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]።»
am.B: እንዲህ አልኳቸው፦ «እያንዳንዳችሁ የምትመለከቷቸውን ርኩሳን ጣዖታት ጣሉ፤ በግብፅም ጣዖታት ራሳችሁን አታርክሱ። እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።»
am.R: እንዲህ አልኳቸው፦ «እያንዳንዳችሁ ማየት የምትወዷቸውን ርኩሳን ጣዖታት ጣሉ። የግብፅን ጣዖታት በማምለክ ራሳችሁን አታርክሱ። እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።»

hi.L: और मैंने उनसे कहा, "तुममें से हर एक अपनी आँखों की घिनौनी वस्तुओं को फेंक दे, और मिस्र की घिनौनी मूरतों से अपने आप को अशुद्ध न करो; मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ]।"
hi.B: मैंने उनसे कहा, "तुममें से हर एक उन घिनौनी मूर्तियों को फेंक दे जिन पर उसकी आँखें लगी हैं, और मिस्र की मूरतों से अपने आप को अशुद्ध न करो। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ।"
hi.R: मैंने उनसे कहा, "तुममें से हर एक उन घिनौनी मूर्तियों को फेंक दे जिन्हें देखना उसे अच्छा लगता है। मिस्र की मूरतों की पूजा करके अपने आप को अशुद्ध न करो। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ।"

ru.L: И сказал {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} им: «Каждый, отбросьте гнусности ваших глаз и не оскверняйте себя грязными идолами Египта; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.»
ru.B: Я сказал им: «Пусть каждый из вас выбросит мерзких идолов, на которых вы смотрите, и не оскверняйте себя идолами Египта. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.»
ru.R: Я сказал им: «Пусть каждый из вас выбросит отвратительных идолов, на которых вы так любите смотреть. Не оскверняйте себя поклонением идолам Египта. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.»

ja.L: わたしは彼らに言った。「おのおの、自分の目の忌むべきものを投げ捨てよ。エジプトの汚らわしい偶像で、身を汚すな。わたしはあなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」
ja.B: わたしは彼らに言った。「あなたがたはおのおの、自分の目が慕う忌まわしい偶像を投げ捨てなさい。エジプトの偶像で身を汚してはならない。わたしはあなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」
ja.R: わたしは彼らに言った。「あなたたちはみな、見るのを好む汚らわしい偶像を投げ捨てなさい。エジプトの偶像を拝んで、身を汚してはいけない。わたしはあなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。」

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказав їм: «Кожен [із вас], відкиньте мерзоти своїх очей і не оскверняйтеся бридкими ідолами Єгипту; Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.»
uk.B: Я сказав їм: «Кожен із вас мусить відкинути мерзенних ідолів, на яких дивиться, і не робіть себе нечистими ідолами Єгипту. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.»
uk.R: Я сказав їм: «Кожен із вас мусить викинути огидних ідолів, на яких любить дивитися. Не робіть себе нечистими, поклоняючись ідолам Єгипту. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.»

decisions.choice: the idols of Egypt: Israel worshiped Egypt's gods while still in Egypt
decisions.reason: The book of Exodus does not tell of Israel worshiping idols in Egypt, but Joshua 24:14 tells the people to put away "the gods your fathers served beyond the River and in Egypt", and the golden calf (Exodus 32) shows how ready they were to make one. Ezekiel returns to Israel's idolatry in Egypt in 23:3, 8, 19 and 27.

decisions.choice: the detestable things of his eyes: the idols each person looked to with desire and devotion
decisions.reason: To lift one's eyes to an idol is to look to it for help and to worship it (18:6, 12, 15). The "detestable things" are the idols themselves, a word Ezekiel uses with contempt (5:11; 7:20).

decisions.choice: idols: Ezekiel's scornful word for idols
decisions.reason: The word for idols here is the one Ezekiel uses most often, a word of contempt; see the note at 6:4.

decisions.choice: the vile idols you look to (B); the disgusting idols you love to look at (R)
alternatives: the detestable things of his eyes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the detestable things are idols, as the book's word list sets out, and turn "of his eyes" into the looking it means (m2). Readable adds "by worshiping" to say how the idols make them unclean.

decisions.choice: cosas detestables (L), ídolos viles (B), ídolos repugnantes (R) for shiqqutsim; ídolos inmundos (L), ídolos (B, R) for gillulim
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's two scornful words for idols are kept apart from each other and from 'abominación' (to'evah) at L; 'ídolos inmundos' at L follows Spanish 2 Kings 17:12.

decisions.choice: shiqqutsim: 혐오스러운 것들 (L), 역겨운 우상들 (B), 더러운 우상들 (R); gillulim: 더러운 우상들 (L), 우상들 (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for Ezekiel's two scornful words for idols, kept apart from to'evah (가증한 일, 역겨운 짓).

decisions.choice: "vitu vya kuchukiza" (L), "sanamu za kuchukiza" (B, R) for shiqqutsim; "sanamu chafu" (L), "sanamu" (B, R) for gillulim
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording. Literal keeps shiqqutsim apart from to'evah ("machukizo"), since Ezekiel uses both words; used through these chapters.

decisions.choice: *shiqqutsim* "choses détestables" (L), "idoles abjectes" (B), "idoles dégoûtantes" (R); *gillulim* "idoles immondes" (L), "idoles" (B, R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The settled French terms for Ezekiel's two scornful words for idols, kept apart at Literal.

decisions.choice: shiqqutsim "vật đáng ghê tởm" (L) / "thần tượng gớm ghiếc" (B) / "thần tượng ghê tởm" (R); gillulim "thần tượng nhơ bẩn" (L) / "thần tượng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's book-wide words, as Deuteronomy 29:16 and Leviticus 26:30; Literal keeps the scorn of gillulim with "nhơ bẩn", as the English Literal says "filthy".

decisions.choice: detestable things (shiqqutsim) "ርኩሰቶች" (L), "ርኩሳን ጣዖታት" (B, R); idols (gillulim) "ጣዖታት"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has two words, kept apart from each other and from toʿevot ("አስጸያፊ ነገሮች"): Literal names the detestable things, Balanced and Readable call them vile idols, as the English. Make unclean (tamaʾ) "አረከሰ", as the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: घिनौनी वस्तुएँ / घिनौनी मूर्तियाँ (shiqqutsim); घिनौनी मूरतें / मूरतें (gillulim)
decisions.reason: Two scornful words for idols stand side by side. Shiqqutsim keep the forms of Ezekiel 11:18 (घिनौनी वस्तुएँ at Literal, घिनौनी मूर्तियाँ at Balanced and Readable); gillulim are घिनौनी मूरतें at Literal and मूरतें at Balanced and Readable, as chapter 18.

decisions.choice: гнусности ваших глаз (L); мерзкие идолы, на которых вы смотрите (B); отвратительные идолы, на которых вы так любите смотреть (R)
decisions.reason: Shiqquts is "гнусность", kept apart from "мерзость" (to'evah), as the Russian Ezekiel 5:11 and 11:18; Balanced and Readable say that these are idols and turn "of his eyes" into the looking it means (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: God's commands inside the history: "〜せよ / 〜するな" (L), "〜しなさい / 〜してはならない" (B), "〜しなさい / 〜してはいけない" (R), the oracle forms, also 20:18-20, 20:39.
decisions.reason: Ezekiel / Jeremiah convention for God's message.

decisions.choice: shiqqutse 'enav "自分の目の忌むべきもの" (L), "自分の目が慕う忌まわしい偶像" (B), "見るのを好む汚らわしい偶像" (R); the same in 20:8.
decisions.reason: m2; shiqqutsim as EZK-1 (忌むべきもの / 忌まわしい偶像 / 汚らわしい偶像).

source.text: וַיַּמְרוּ־בִ֗י וְלֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ לִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלַ֔י אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־שִׁקּוּצֵ֤י עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׁלִ֔יכוּ וְאֶת־גִּלּוּלֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֣א עָזָ֑בוּ וָאֹמַ֞ר לִשְׁפֹּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכַלּ֤וֹת אַפִּי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: But they rebelled against me and were not willing to listen to me; each [man] the detestable things of their eyes they did not throw away, and the idols of Egypt they did not forsake. And I said to pour out my wrath on them, to spend my anger on them in [the] midst of [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: But they rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and were not willing to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; they did not, each one, throw away the detestable things of their eyes, and they did not forsake the filthy idols of Egypt. Then I said [that I would] pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on them, to spend {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on them there in the midst of the land of Egypt.
en.B: But they rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and refused to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. None of them threw away the vile idols they looked to, and they did not abandon the idols of Egypt. So I said that I would pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on them and use up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger against them there in the land of Egypt.
en.R: But they rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and would not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Not one of them threw away the disgusting idols they loved to look at. They kept on worshiping the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on them and punish them fully while they were still in Egypt.

pt.L: Mas eles se rebelaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e não quiseram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouvir; não lançaram fora, cada um, as coisas detestáveis dos seus olhos, e não abandonaram os ídolos imundos do Egito. Então eu disse [que] derramaria o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor sobre eles, para esgotar a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira contra eles ali, no meio da terra do Egito.
pt.B: Mas eles se rebelaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e se recusaram a {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouvir. Nenhum deles jogou fora os ídolos vis para os quais olhava, e não abandonaram os ídolos do Egito. Então eu disse que derramaria o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor sobre eles e esgotaria a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira contra eles ali, na terra do Egito.
pt.R: Mas eles se rebelaram contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e não quiseram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouvir. Nenhum deles jogou fora os ídolos repugnantes que gostava de olhar. Continuaram adorando os ídolos do Egito. Então eu disse que derramaria a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira sobre eles e os castigaria por completo enquanto ainda estavam no Egito.

fr.L: Mais ils se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et n’ont pas voulu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter ; ils n’ont pas, chacun, jeté les choses détestables de leurs yeux, et ils n’ont pas abandonné les idoles immondes d’Égypte. Alors j’ai dit [que je] répandrais {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur eux, pour assouvir {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère contre eux au milieu du pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Mais ils se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et ont refusé de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter. Aucun d’eux n’a rejeté les idoles abjectes vers lesquelles il tournait ses regards, et ils n’ont pas abandonné les idoles d’Égypte.
